channel.title: Little Gasp – interactive surprise websites
channel.description: Little Gasp (littlegasp.com) makes interactive surprise websites for birthdays, love letters, apologies and Indian festivals.

item.title: Love letter surprise website for your partner
item.description: A love letter they open on their phone: a dove delivers it, they crack the wax seal, unfold your notes and watch a quill write every word. Add your photos and words, preview free at littlegasp.com.

item.title: Sorry surprise website to apologise to your partner
item.description: Say sorry properly: they mend a broken heart with gold, open a jar of your promises and tell you honestly how mad they still are. Add your words and photos, preview free at littlegasp.com.

item.title: Diwali surprise website for partner, family or Bhai Dooj
item.description: Light up their Diwali: trace a glowing rangoli, write wishes in the sky with a sparkler and hide your real gift under gold foil. Preview free at littlegasp.com.

item.title: Karwa Chauth surprise website for your wife
item.description: A moon of their own: raise the channi, light the diyas and pass the puja thali around for seven promises, with your photos and words. Preview free at littlegasp.com.

item.title: Teddy bear birthday surprise website
item.description: A teddy bear's birthday party they play: light the candles, blow out a wish, pop balloons, unwrap your photos and cut the cake. Pink or blue. Preview free at littlegasp.com.

item.title: Birthday surprise website with photos and wishes
item.description: A birthday they can play: candles, a wish, your photos and little notes, ending with a birthday selfie with a crown. Preview free at littlegasp.com.

item.title: Navratri Garba surprise website for your partner
item.description: Light all nine Navratri nights by tapping the dancing couple, each one opening a photo or a reason, then play a dandiya round to the beat. Preview free at littlegasp.com.

item.title: Anniversary surprise website for your wife or husband
item.description: An anniversary ride for two: helmets on, kick-start the scooter and drive up memory lane, where every milestone is one of your photos. Promises, a chai-stop letter and a love lock on the bridge. Preview free at littlegasp.com.
